snippet.title: Corsair Cove Announcement Trailer | Pirate City Builder
snippet.description:
Corsair Cove is a city builder that challenges you to think tall as you build without constraints on cliff-faces and hilltops and manage complex production chains that span across great lengths and heights. Establish a pirate haven and manufacture everything from spyglasses to cannons, equip your crew, and build mighty ships to take to the seas and wage war against the Crown.

WISHLIST on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1368140/Corsair_Cove/
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/corsair-cove-35fa64
